guardControl.scope: One isolated copy of actual offline-installed products, normal source/consumer unchanged

scope: One actual held seven-family native/upload preflight constructs every concrete reconstruction recipe. Both literal room inputs, all output files, exact selections/digests/MIME and a complete per-participant source/output/namespace plan are retained in one immutable absent-only intent before any participant targets exist. Independent existing-only cold DATA read verifies the complete archive and source topology. Four history pairings, genuine failed-save newer retained input, unchanged source rows, lost completion, atomic abort, cancellation during decoding, actual queued-open cleanup, stale plans and bounded storage reads are exercised in source, offline installed packages and actual production bundle.
limitations: Preparation retains complete per-participant target plans but does not execute replacement roots, participant targets or selected upload adoption.
Cold file/intent admission is DATA, not native mutable admission, a writer retirement, source-save acknowledgement, provider receipt, permission or activation.
Preparation targets are checked absent but not reserved for a later executor. An already committed preparation survives lost completion or subsequent current-cut refusal.
The distinct total budget is 1GiB including two full snapshots and all outputs, with16MiB header and1024 members. Overflow refuses without truncating history.
Controlled IDB/raster/native-host tests do not establish physical power-loss durability.
Rust/build inputs and normal Wasm are unchanged; Rust suites, prior execution/flat matrices and full candidate profiles are not claimed as rerun.
remaining: Whole-room root/target execution and durable per-member progress; approved old-writer retirement and interruption replay/handoff; compatible native/dependent-packet reconciliation; comment adoption; authenticated activation/fencing; sustainable Undo/offline retention; extension/full parity and all thirteen release gates.
